baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired seeing and showing verbs at words 2 and 8, the creation and share alternatives at words 10 and 15, and the book and trace alternatives at words 19 and 24.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah stages an escalating audit. It begins by making the addressees inspect their own claim, asks for an attributable product on the lower visible plane, allows the alternative of demonstrable participation in the upper order, and then requests either organized documentation or a surviving mark. The truth clause makes each route answerable to evidence rather than assertion.

activation_trace.role: The alerting interrogative use makes the audience report what it actually takes itself to know and opens the audit.
Active disclosure turns the claim from something merely said into something that must be put on display.
Origination supplies the first and strongest production test: identify something these beings brought into existence.
Participation supplies the alternative test of an attributable portion or role within the celestial order.
Joined and ordered writing provides a documentary route for a claim that cannot be demonstrated by an artifact.
A remaining sign supplies the residual route: a past act may still be known through what it left behind.
Agreement between speech and reality closes the audit by making evidence the condition of truthful assertion.

changed_reading.before: A general rhetorical denial that other deities created anything.
changed_reading.after: A falsifiable, multi-channel audit that permits material, jurisdictional, documentary, and residual evidence, yet finds the claimants unable to produce any of them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of a claimed share at word 15 with a book from before at words 19-21 and a transmitted trace at word 24.
baseline_models.mechanism: The vocabulary supports a jurisdictional reading. A share is not established by devotion alone; it needs a prior warrant, binding record, or transmitted chain showing how that share was granted. The request resembles an audit of title to cosmic authority rather than a request for any impressive old text.

activation_trace.role: A jointly held portion supplies the legal and social relation whose authorization is being challenged.
A written determination that fixes obligation or judgment supplies the image of an authoritative charter rather than bare writing.
Temporal precedence requires the alleged authorization to predate the present challenge and gives it a chain-of-title function.
A report preserved through transmission supplies the non-documentary alternative to a formal charter.
Veracity requires the alleged warrant and the asserted share to correspond to an actual grant.

changed_reading.before: Bring any earlier scripture that mentions the invoked beings.
changed_reading.after: Produce an antecedent warrant or preserved chain that actually authorizes their claimed share in governance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compact construction joining the trace at word 24 to knowledge at word 26, after the repeated demand to see.
baseline_models.mechanism: The trace and knowledge roots reinforce one another as sign language. A residue counts only when it distinguishes its cause and can guide an observer toward knowledge. The ayah therefore does not accept mere antiquity, unexplained objects, or inherited rumor as proof; it asks for a residue with evidentiary resolution.

activation_trace.role: A durable remainder points backward to a prior cause and supplies the physical side of the evidentiary sign.
A distinguishing marker that guides its reader supplies the interpretive side that makes a remainder probative.
Disclosure to a knower states the result required from the trace: not fascination, but warranted recognition.
Perception by eye or insight supplies the reader who must connect the surviving mark to what it demonstrates.

changed_reading.before: A trace is any relic or fragment inherited from the past.
changed_reading.after: The requested trace must be legible as knowledge: a discriminating remainder that can identify and support the alleged causal claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The beings called at word 4 are located beneath or other than God at word 6 before their alleged share is tested at word 15.
baseline_models.mechanism: The spatial relation can include beings imagined as near but below the ultimate goal, not only fully independent rivals. The ayah tests delegated mediation as rigorously as competing divinity: invocation, subordinate location, and alleged participation together require evidence of an actual authorized function.

activation_trace.role: Calling that draws an addressee toward the caller supplies the operative relationship claimed with these beings.
Nearness that remains short of the goal supplies the model of a subordinate intermediary rather than only a distant rival.
The relation of worship identifies the ultimate divine referent against whom the subordinate claim is measured.
Participation supplies the alleged delegated function that would make mediation more than projected devotion.

changed_reading.before: The ayah addresses only rival creator-gods set wholly apart from God.
changed_reading.after: It also audits subordinate mediators: proximity, invocation, and claimed participation do not establish delegated authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The creation question at word 10 is immediately paired with the alternative of a share at word 15 across earth and heavens.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation can be heard as prior measuring and proportioning as well as origination. Paired with participation, the challenge asks for an identifiable design allocation: what did the invoked beings specify, proportion, or administer within the earth-heavens system? This is a test of ordered causal competence, not only manufacture.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the design dimension of creation and makes ordered contribution testable.
Bringing creation into existence keeps the design reading tethered to effective production rather than abstract planning.
The lower plane supplies the inspectable domain in which an alleged allocation should leave products.
The encompassing upper realm supplies the larger order in which an alleged share would have to be located.
A joint portion turns measured creation into an allocation question: identify the other party's actual contribution.

changed_reading.before: Show an object independently manufactured by the invoked beings.
changed_reading.after: Identify any measurable design, proportion, or effective allocation attributable to them within the created order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding context supplies the positive comparator that the focus challenge leaves implicit: a book is presently delivered from God, while the heavens and earth are created in stable correspondence with reality and a fixed term. The absent warrant for the invoked beings is thus contrasted with both an identified communication and an ordered creation.

activation_trace.role: Ordered writing is the documentary channel whose requested prior instance anchors this delta in the focus ayah.
Delivery from above supplies an actual, sourced communication against which the requested book can be compared.
The present organized text supplies the positive documentary object immediately before the challenge for an older one.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the governing quality of creation and the benchmark for a truthful claim.
A bounded appointed duration supplies temporal order, making creation a governed system rather than an unexplained mass.

structural_cues: 46:2 identifies a present book before 46:4 requests a book from before.
46:3 repeats creation, heavens, and earth immediately before the focus ayah repeats them as the audit domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a delivered book and creation ordered by reality and term; I infer that they function as positive comparators to the missing idol evidence. A live alternative is that 46:2-3 establish divine authorship generally without defining the focus ayah's proof procedure.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah asks for evidence in an otherwise neutral field.
changed_reading.after: It asks for rival evidence in a field already occupied by a sourced book and a temporally ordered creation, making the rivals' evidentiary absence sharper.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context operationalizes invocation as a reciprocal relation. The called beings do not answer, remain unaware, reverse into enemies, fail to help despite being taken as offerings of proximity, and provide no protective alliance. The focus question about creation or celestial participation therefore becomes a stress test of practical agency and authorized mediation.

activation_trace.role: Calling establishes the relation whose capacity for response and aid the context subsequently tests.
A near but subordinate position supplies the mediation claim that would require dependable access and protection.
Participation supplies the alleged functional share that failed response and protection would disconfirm.
Returning an answer supplies the minimal reciprocal act that the invoked beings cannot perform.
Being outside awareness supplies the cognitive failure behind their non-response.
Enmity supplies the social reversal of the claimed devotional alliance when the parties are gathered.
Aid that makes its beneficiary prevail supplies the protective function the supposed gods fail to deliver.
An offering intended to secure nearness supplies the cultic mechanism by which the beings were treated as intermediaries.
Protective affection and alliance supply the final relational function explicitly denied to those placed beneath God.

structural_cues: 46:5 repeats the focus ayah's calling and subordinate-location construction, then adds non-response.
46:6 reverses worship into enmity, while 46:28 and 46:32 return to failed help and absent allies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, non-response, unawareness, enmity, failed aid, and absent alliance; I infer that response and protection are functional tests of a claimed mediator's share. A live alternative is that these are consequences of false worship rather than criteria embedded in 46:4 itself.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah asks only whether the invoked beings once produced a cosmic object.
changed_reading.after: It also asks whether they possess any current, reciprocal agency: awareness, answer, aid, stable alliance, or authorized mediation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context fills out the focus ayah's documentary alternative as a chain of custody. A witness speaks from knowledge, the book of Moses precedes, the present book confirms, and the later hearers identify a book delivered after Moses that confirms what lies before it. A prior book or transmitted trace must therefore fit a cross-checkable sequence, not merely be old.

activation_trace.role: An authoritative written determination anchors the delta in the focus demand for a warrant rather than any writing.
Preserved transmission supplies the alternative chain by which knowledge can survive without the original document.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies an independently reportable link in the evidentiary chain.
The two organized texts in one ayah supply an explicit earlier-and-present documentary sequence.
Making an earlier claim come true in a later act supplies confirmation rather than mere chronological succession.
A delivered book supplies a source event that later hearers can place after Moses within the chain.
Fulfilled correspondence with what precedes supplies the cross-check that stabilizes the chain across time.

structural_cues: 46:12 verbally answers the focus phrase about a book from before by placing Moses's book before the present one.
46:30 repeats the same sequence from the perspective of new hearers and adds confirmation of what precedes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness, temporal succession, two books, and repeated confirmation; I infer a chain-of-custody standard for the requested evidence. A live alternative is that each item independently supports revelation without forming a single archival protocol.

changed_reading.before: Any ancient text or inherited report could satisfy the request if it mentioned the invoked beings.
changed_reading.after: The requested evidence must enter a witnessed, temporally located, mutually confirming transmission chain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context limits both the knower and the perceiver. The messenger disclaims independent knowledge and follows disclosed news; knowledge is located with God; and hearing, sight, and inward faculties fail to avail people who knowingly reject signs. The focus command to show evidence is therefore not naive empiricism. Perception must be joined to warranted disclosure, understanding, and honest reception.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight anchors the delta in the focus ayah's repeated appeal to perception.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic result that perception alone cannot guarantee.
Acquired knowledge supplies the capacity the messenger explicitly refuses to claim independently.
News or inspiration from God supplies the warranted source that replaces unsupported foresight.
Knowledge located with God supplies an explicit boundary on the human claimant's epistemic authority.
Understanding and compliance supply the unrealized function of hearing, beyond mere reception of sound.
Inner discernment supplies the unrealized function of sight, beyond registering a visible surface.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the mechanism by which available faculties cease to yield acknowledgment.

structural_cues: 46:9 places an epistemic disclaimer soon after the focus challenge, while 46:23 repeats that knowledge is with God.
46:26 inventories hearing and sight but states that they did not avail their possessors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded knowledge, divine disclosure, unused faculties, and knowing denial; I infer that honest uptake mediates between a displayed sign and knowledge. A live alternative is that these passages concern obedience and prophetic humility without qualifying the proof request itself.

changed_reading.before: Once an object is shown, sight automatically settles the claim.
changed_reading.after: Showing initiates an evidentiary process, but warranted source, discernment, and truthful reception determine whether the visible becomes knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated confirmation and the promise characterized by truth activate a performative branch of truth. In the focus closing condition, being truthful can therefore require more than accurate speech: the claim about the invoked beings must be realized in a fulfilled act, dependable promise, or effective function.

activation_trace.role: Speech matching its object supplies the ordinary truth test from which the contextual revision begins.
Making a claim or promise actual in deed supplies the stronger performative criterion latent in the same focus word.
A later book realizing and confirming what precedes supplies an enacted form of correspondence across time.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the future-directed claim that truth must eventually fulfill.
Fulfillment in action supplies the quality that makes the promise dependable rather than merely well phrased.
The opponents' demand that a promised outcome be brought supplies a hostile but explicit test of claim by realization.

structural_cues: Truth language recurs with a confirming book in 46:12 and a promise in 46:16.
46:22 pairs a demand to bring the promised event with the same conditional truth formula used in the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confirmation, promise, and demanded realization; I infer that the focus truth condition can test performance as well as verbal accuracy. A live alternative is that the repeated formula is only conventional challenge language and leaves the lexical sense at truthful speech.

changed_reading.before: The closing condition asks whether the speakers sincerely state a proposition.
changed_reading.after: It also asks whether their claim can become true in performance: can the alleged partners deliver the creative, protective, or authorizing function attributed to them?

context_deltas.mechanism: The cloud episode separates seeing from correct classification. A visible phenomenon approaching the valleys is read as beneficial rain but proves destructive; afterward only dwellings remain visible, and nearby settlements become repeatedly varied signs. This changes the focus pair of showing and trace: a surface appearance may mislead, while an absence framed by a surviving remainder may disclose the real cause.

activation_trace.role: Eye and insight together anchor the delta in the focus demand to inspect rather than merely hear a claim.
A surviving indication anchors the contextual dwellings as an analogy for evidence left after an absent cause or population.
Something appearing from a direction supplies the ambiguous visible object that observers prematurely classify.
Rain that descends as harm supplies the reversal hidden inside what the observers expected to be beneficial weather.
Comprehensive destruction supplies the causal event no longer directly visible after it passes.
Restricted visibility supplies the aftermath in which what is not seen becomes as evidentially important as what remains.
Places of settled habitation supply the durable remainder from which the vanished inhabitants and event are inferred.
Turning signs through different forms supplies repeated interpretive opportunities rather than a single self-explaining sight.

structural_cues: 46:24 repeats seeing but records an incorrect interpretation of what is seen.
46:25 follows destruction with a visual field containing only dwellings, and 46:27 labels nearby ruined settlements through varied signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a misclassified appearance, destructive reversal, restricted aftermath, and remaining dwellings; I infer that the dwellings function as an evidentiary trace and that absence can be legible. A live alternative is that the sequence illustrates punishment alone and does not qualify the focus ayah's epistemology.

changed_reading.before: Visible presence is straightforward proof, while a trace is a weaker substitute for sight.
changed_reading.after: Visible surfaces can be misread, whereas a properly interpreted remainder, including conspicuous absence around what survives, can carry stronger causal knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final movement supplies a positive counterpart to the failed invocation. Hearers attend to a gathered recitation, listen in silence, return as warners, and command their people to answer God's caller. Agency is shown as a reproducible response chain: receive, understand, answer, and transmit. The beings called in the focus ayah generate none of these effects.

activation_trace.role: Calling establishes the focus relation whose productive counterpart appears when hearers answer and become callers themselves.
Understanding that issues in compliance supplies effective hearing rather than passive sound reception.
Recitation supplies the transmissible content around which the responsive audience gathers.
Attentive silence supplies the receptive posture that allows the call to become understood evidence.
Returning an answer supplies the decisive relational act absent from the beings invoked beneath God.
A caller who draws others by speech supplies the reversed grammar: the proper call now has a messenger, content, and expected response.

structural_cues: The root for calling shifts from the object of human invocation in 46:4-5 to God's caller in 46:31.
46:29-31 forms a sequence of hearing, attentive silence, return, warning, and answering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a complete reception-and-response sequence; I infer that productive response is positive evidence of live agency and that its absence exposes the focus objects. A live alternative is that the later call concerns human responsibility without serving as a direct comparator to invoked beings.

changed_reading.before: Calling is primarily the worshipper's act directed toward a sacred object.
changed_reading.after: A valid call is evidenced by a response network that receives, understands, answers, and retransmits; inert invocation has no such causal output.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, the context deliberately reprises seeing, God, creation, heavens, and earth, then asks whether the creator was unable and asserts effective capacity over restoring the dead. This closes the focus audit by extending creation from a past artifact to continuing, measured power. A genuine creator is not merely associated with origins but can execute the order's next transformation.

activation_trace.role: Measured design anchors the delta in the focus demand for an attributable contribution to ordered creation.
An alleged joint portion anchors the question of whether any other agent possesses effective capacity within that order.
Perception by eye or insight reopens the same evidentiary posture used in the focus ayah.
Proportioned creation is repeated as the established work from which present capacity is inferred.
Failure to find the way to an act supplies the incapacity explicitly denied of the creator.
Effective enablement reaching action and dominion supplies the positive capacity inferred from creation.
Loss of life supplies the apparently final condition over which continuing creative capacity is tested.

structural_cues: 46:33 repeats the focus sequence of seeing, God, creating, heavens, and earth before adding ability and restored life.
The late reprise functions as a lexical return to the initial creation challenge rather than an unrelated topic shift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near-verbatim lexical reprise followed by inability and capacity; I infer a causal arrow from demonstrated creation to power for re-creation. A live alternative is that 46:33 independently argues resurrection and only echoes 46:4 rhetorically.

changed_reading.before: The creation test concerns only a recoverable product from the remote past.
changed_reading.after: The test concerns durable causal capacity: ordered creation should entail power to continue, transform, and restore life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the trace word and should not replace its ordinary residual or transmitted senses. It remains anchored in word 24, the imperative to produce evidence, and the later variation of signs. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory resonance: the challenge may ask claimants to raise any latent proof into view, not translate the word as stirring.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The trace noun at word 24 appears inside an imperative demand to bring evidence into the open.

activation_trace.role: Moving something from its place supplies an image of eliciting or excavating proof that had remained unavailable.
Emergence and visible spread after concealment supply the result demanded of any allegedly latent knowledge.
Turning signs through multiple states supplies a contextual analogy for drawing different evidentiary forms into notice.

changed_reading.before: The claimants may point to a static remnant already lying in view.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the imperative challenges them to excavate, activate, or raise whatever supposedly hidden knowledge could become inspectable proof.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the packet's split mapping from the paired seeing verbs into deliberation and report-transmission. It remains worth carrying because the focus ayah itself moves from showing to book and preserved report, and context adds knowledgeable witness. Downstream prose should label it a phonetic or mapped-root resonance, never an alternative lexical translation of the seeing verbs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two seeing verbs at words 2 and 8 govern a sequence that ends with documentary and transmitted evidence.

activation_trace.role: Carrying and transmitting a report supplies an exploratory second channel inside the repeated demand to see and show.
Deliberative consideration supplies the reflective act needed to assess the displayed or reported evidence.
A report preserved through transmission supplies the focus ayah's explicit bridge from direct display to narrated knowledge.
A witness speaking from knowledge supplies the contextual form of a report that is answerable to what was known.

changed_reading.before: The repeated verbs demand only immediate ocular demonstration.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they braid inspection with reliable narration: what can be seen, thoughtfully assessed, and carried forward as a knowledgeable report?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split mapping from the heavens root to visible marking; the normal celestial sense remains controlling. It is still anchored by the heavenly-share question and the nearby trace-plus-marker construction. Downstream prose should render it only as an audit image: inspect the heavens for an identifying mark of participation, not redefine the heavens as marks.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The alleged share in the heavens at words 15-17 is followed by a request for a knowledge-bearing trace at words 24-26.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies the exploratory image of a celestial order bearing attribution to its alleged participant.
A sign from which an observer reads a condition supplies the mechanism for inspecting the alleged heavenly share.
A durable indication supplies the kind of attributable remainder that the heavens would need to exhibit.
A marker that distinguishes and guides supplies the interpretive criterion for any alleged celestial signature.

changed_reading.before: A heavenly share is an invisible jurisdictional assertion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, even that assertion is pressed toward inspectability: where is the identifying mark or signature of the alleged participant in the celestial order?

strongest_changes: Invocation becomes a functional test of awareness, response, aid, and stable alliance rather than only a label for worship.
The requested prior book or trace becomes a witnessed and mutually confirming chain rather than any ancient object.
The cloud, destruction, and remaining dwellings distinguish raw visibility from correctly interpreted residue.
The late creation reprise extends the audit from past products to continuing capacity for transformation and restored life.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah already permits several proof channels instead of forcing one, and the context differentiates them further: present revelation, causal workmanship, delegated function, historical transmission, perceptual interpretation, and performed truth. The split mappings also activate contained but coherent readings of elicited evidence, seeing as report, and the heavens as an inspectable marked order.
remaining_uncertainties: The charter or title-deed force of the book branch is coherent with partnership language but remains an analogy rather than a required legal register.
The report, stirring, and marking outliers depend on non-dominant mapped roots and should remain resonances rather than translations.
The cloud-to-dwellings sequence may be primarily a punishment narrative rather than a direct instruction about evidence interpretation.
The contextual promise language makes performed truth plausible, but the focus closing condition may still intend verbal truthfulness alone.
